'''Hydraulic jacks''' were a type of tool used for [[Mining/Legends|mining]] [[Cortosis/Legends|cortosis]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Apatros/Legends|Apatros]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[New Sith Wars]]. [[Darth Bane/Legends|Dessel]], a miner on the colony who later joined the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]] and eventually became [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Bane, used hydraulic jacks.
